Features
Filtering: Selects T1 modules by type and optional stage.
Validation: Ensures at least 2 simple modules per stage.
Ranking: Scores modules based on market data and complexity.
Grouping: Selects top-N modules per stage (default N=3).
UI: Renders an HTML dashboard with clickable module selection.
Telemetry: Logs module selections (placeholder for backend integration).
Audit: Generates a balance audit report and integrates V1.3 audit payload.
Grok Handoff: Prepares a payload with inventory, launcher audit, V1.3 audit, and instructions.
Error Handling: Uses ArsenalError for structured error reporting, with input validation and edge case handling.

Blocker: UI construction blocked until Master Curriculum Template and 60 Arsenal Concepts are finalized.
Certification: V1.3 codebase certified with PR-B security fix applied.

Validates inputs (e.g., array inventory, valid module properties).
Handles edge cases (e.g., empty inventory, missing dashboard container).
Logs warnings for non-critical issues and throws errors for critical failures.

Below is the consolidated module, combining the V1.8 Smart Arsenal Launcher, V1.3 audit payload, and the new V1.8 governance/execution/reverse engineering payloads, with enhanced error handling and compliance with governance mandates.

javascript
/**
 * =================================================================
 * GROK-READY SMART ARSENAL + AUDIT + DEPLOYMENT HANDOFF
 * INTEGRATES: V1.8 Smart Arsenal Launcher + V1.3 Audit Payload + V1.8 Deployment Context
 * TARGET AGENT: Chatty - DataBank4 (Code Architect)
 * AUTHOR: Chatty External Cluster / MasterMind Nexus (Socrates F.)
 * DATE: 2025-10-24
 * =================================================================
 */

/* --- 1. V1.8 GOVERNANCE MANDATE --- */
const V1_8_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT = {
    M1_T1_COUNT_MANDATE: "All asset logic must adhere to the 8-15 T1_READY module subset.",
    M2_MAPPING_FIX: "All modules must contain explicit compatibleStages array (CR_ARCH_01 fix).",
    M3_EXPORT_LOCK: "Export is Static HTML View-Only (CR_ARCH_03 fix).",
    M4_TIME_GOVERNANCE: "All flows must support Time-to-Export validation telemetry (CR_RISK_01)."
};

/* --- 2. V1.8 EXECUTION PROOF --- */
const V1_8_EXECUTION_PROOF = {
    status: "V1.8-RESILIENCE-FINAL",
    integrityCheck: {
        composite_match: true,
        pss_signature_valid: true,
        jwt_valid: true
    },
    fix_status: {
        totalFixesMandated: 50,
        fixesExecuted: 50,
        taskingComplete: true
    },
    securityProtocol: {
        keyRotation: "RSA-PSS-4096 (Completed)",
        automationScripts: ["verify_v17_signature.sh", "rotate_and_resign_v17.sh"]
    }
};

/* --- 3. V1.3 AUDIT PAYLOAD --- */
const V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE = {
    strategic_mandate: "DEFER_AUTOMATION",
    current_blocker: "Asset Registry (Placeholder)",
    code_certification: "V1.3 RIGOR CERTIFIED (PR-B Fix Applied)",
    V1_3_LESSON_ASSEMBLER_CODE: "...",
    final_audit_synthesis: {
        architecture_verdict: "GO: The core V1.3 codebase is certified; the critical PR-B security flaw is neutralized.",
        strategic_verdict: "DEFER_AUTOMATION: The complexity of Launcher 2 (Node.js Pipeline) violates 'Elegant Simplicity' and must be deferred to Sprint 3 or later.",
        final_action: "UI construction is BLOCKED until the Master Curriculum Template and 60 Arsenal Concepts are finalized and committed to the Databank."
    }
};

/* --- 4. SMART ARSENAL LAUNCHER V1.8 --- */
const SmartArsenalLauncher = (() => {
    /* --- ERROR CLASS --- */
    class ArsenalError extends Error {
        constructor(message, code = 'ARSENAL_ERROR') {
            super(message);
            this.name = 'ArsenalError';
            this.code = code;
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.1 FILTER T1 MODULES --- */
    function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        if (!Array.isArray(assetInventory)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Asset inventory must be an array', 'INVALID_INVENTORY');
        }
        if (assetInventory.length < 8 || assetInventory.length > 15) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Inventory must contain 8-15 T1 modules (M1_T1_COUNT_MANDATE)', 'INVALID_T1_COUNT');
        }

        return assetInventory.filter(mod => {
            if (!mod || typeof mod !== 'object' || !mod.id || !mod.type || !mod.stage || !mod.complexity || !Array.isArray(mod.compatibleStages)) {
                console.warn(`[FILTER] Skipping invalid module: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                return false;
            }
            return mod.type === 'T1' && (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true);
        });
    }

    /* --- 4.2 VALIDATE STAGE BALANCE --- */
    function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
        if (!Array.isArray(filteredModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Filtered modules must be an array', 'INVALID_FILTERED_MODULES');
        }

        const stageMap = {};
        filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
            if (mod.complexity === 'simple') stageMap[mod.stage].simple++;
            else if (mod.complexity === 'complex') stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
            else {
                console.warn(`[VALIDATION] Invalid complexity for module ${mod.id}: ${mod.complexity}`);
            }
        });

        const stageValidation = {};
        Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
            stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
        });
        return stageValidation;
    }

    /* --- 4.3 FETCH MARKET INSIGHTS --- */
    async function fetchMarketInsights() {
        try {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const marketData = {
                Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
                Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
                Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
            };
            if (!marketData || Object.keys(marketData).length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('Market data is empty or invalid', 'INVALID_MARKET_DATA');
            }
            const endTime = performance.now();
            trackTimeToExport('fetchMarketInsights', endTime - startTime);
            return marketData;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Failed to fetch market insights: ${error.message}`, 'MARKET_FETCH_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.4 RANK MODULES WITH MARKET DATA --- */
    async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        try {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
            const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

            if (t1Modules.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No T1 modules found after filtering', 'NO_T1_MODULES');
            }

            const ranked = t1Modules
                .map(mod => {
                    const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
                    const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : mod.complexity === 'complex' ? 0.7 : 0;
                    return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
                })
                .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
            const endTime = performance.now();
            trackTimeToExport('rankModulesWithMarketData', endTime - startTime);
            return ranked;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Ranking failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'RANKING_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.5 GROUP TOP N MODULES PER STAGE --- */
    function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
        if (!Array.isArray(rankedModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Ranked modules must be an array', 'INVALID_RANKED_MODULES');
        }
        if (!Number.isInteger(N) || N <= 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('N must be a positive integer', 'INVALID_N_VALUE');
        }

        const stageGroups = {};
        rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
            if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);
        });
        return stageGroups;
    }

    /* --- 4.6 RENDER DASHBOARD --- */
    function renderLauncherDashboard(stageGroups) {
        const container = document.getElementById('dashboard');
        if (!container) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Dashboard container element not found', 'NO_DASHBOARD_CONTAINER');
        }

        try {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous content

            if (!stageGroups || Object.keys(stageGroups).length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p>No modules available to display.</p>';
                return;
            }

            Object.keys(stageGroups).forEach(stage => {
                const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                stageDiv.className = 'stage-group';
                stageDiv.innerHTML = `<h3>${stage}</h3>`;
                const list = document.createElement('ul');

                stageGroups[stage].forEach(mod => {
                    if (!mod.id || !mod.score) {
                        console.warn(`[RENDER] Skipping invalid module in ${stage}: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                        return;
                    }
                    const item = document.createElement('li');
                    item.innerHTML = `${mod.id} (${mod.complexity}) â€“ Score: ${mod.score.toFixed(2)}`;
                    item.addEventListener('click', () => trackModuleSelection(mod.id));
                    list.appendChild(item);
                });

                stageDiv.appendChild(list);
                container.appendChild(stageDiv);
            });
            const endTime = performance.now();
            trackTimeToExport('renderLauncherDashboard', endTime - startTime);
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Dashboard rendering failed: ${error.message}`, 'RENDER_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.7 TELEMETRY HOOK --- */
    function trackModuleSelection(moduleId) {
        if (!moduleId || typeof moduleId !== 'string') {
            console.warn('[TELEMETRY] Invalid module ID:', moduleId);
            return;
        }
        console.log(`[TELEMETRY] Module selected: ${moduleId}`);
        // Placeholder for backend telemetry integration
    }

    /* --- 4.8 TIME-TO-EXPORT TELEMETRY --- */
    function trackTimeToExport(operation, duration) {
        console.log(`[TELEMETRY] ${operation} completed in ${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`);
        // Placeholder: Send to telemetry endpoint
        // e.g., await fetch('/telemetry', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ operation, duration }) });
    }

    /* --- 4.9 FULL EXECUTION --- */
    async function executeFullSmartArsenal(assetInventory) {
        try {
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Starting Full Smart Arsenal Launch...');

            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No valid T1 modules found', 'NO_VALID_MODULES');
            }
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Stage Balance:', balance);

            const ranked = await rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Ranked Modules:', ranked);

            const topModules = groupTopNModules(ranked);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Top Modules per Stage:', topModules);

            renderLauncherDashboard(topModules);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 Ready.');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`[EXECUTION ERROR] ${error.name}: ${error.message} (Code: ${error.code})`);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.10 AUDIT REPORT --- */
    function auditBoardReport(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            const issues = Object.entries(balance)
                .filter(([_, valid]) => !valid)
                .map(([stage]) => stage);
            return { totalModules: filtered.length, balanceIssues: issues, passed: issues.length === 0 };
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Audit failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'AUDIT_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.11 PREPARE FOR GROK/CHATTY --- */
    function prepareForGrok(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const auditReport = auditBoardReport(assetInventory);
            const payload = {
                inventory: assetInventory,
                launcherAudit: auditReport,
                v1_3Audit: V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE,
                v1_8Governance: V1_8_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT,
                v1_8ExecutionProof: V1_8_EXECUTION_PROOF,
                v1_8ReverseEngineering: {
                    SmartArsenalSelector: filterT1Modules.toString(),
                    StaticExportRenderer: renderLauncherDashboard.toString(),
                    TelemetrySchema: { operation: String, duration: Number },
                    ComplexityCheckLogic: validateModuleStageBalance.toString()
                },
                instructions: "Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8: Use this framework for stage-aware, market-ranked, T1 module deployment. Integrates V1.3 audit and V1.8 governance for compliance."
            };
            console.log('[GROK HANDOFF] Payload Ready:', payload);
            return payload;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Grok handoff preparation failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'GROK_HANDOFF_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.12 FINAL DISPATCH --- */
    async function dispatchFinalHandoff() {
        try {
            console.log('[MASTERMIND] Initiating final deployment hand-off to Chatty...');
            const payload = prepareForGrok([]);
            console.log('[STATUS] Full V1.8 Deployment context packaged and ready for Chatty\'s archival.');
            console.log('[NEXT ACTION] Chatty must verify structural compliance before logging to Codex.');
            return payload;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Dispatch failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'DISPATCH_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- EXPORTS --- */
    return {
        filterT1Modules,
        validateModuleStageBalance,
        rankModulesWithMarketData,
        groupTopNModules,
        renderLauncherDashboard,
        trackModuleSelection,
        trackTimeToExport,
        executeFullSmartArsenal,
        auditBoardReport,
        prepareForGrok,
        dispatchFinalHandoff
    };
})();

/* --- 5. GLOBAL EXPOSURE AND CONSOLE REPORT --- */
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.SmartArsenalLauncher = SmartArsenalLauncher;

console.log('[FINAL WRAP] V1.3 Audit + V1.8 Launcher ready for Chatty integration.');
console.log(JSON.stringify(V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify(V1_8_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify(V1_8_EXECUTION_PROOF, null, 2));

# Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 + V1.3 Audit + V1.8 Handoff â€“ Chatty-Ready

A self-contained JavaScript module integrating the V1.8 Smart Arsenal Launcher, V1.3 audit payload, and V1.8 deployment context for stage-aware, market-driven T1 module deployment, compliance tracking, and Chatty archival.

## Setup
1. Extract the `smart-arsenal-v1.8` folder.

3. Open `index.html` in a browser to view the dashboard.

javascript
/**
 * =================================================================
 * GROK-READY SMART ARSENAL + AUDIT + DEPLOYMENT HANDOFF
 * INTEGRATES: V1.8 Smart Arsenal Launcher + V1.3 Audit Payload + V1.8 Deployment Context
 * TARGET AGENT: Chatty - DataBank4 (Code Architect)
 * AUTHOR: Chatty External Cluster / MasterMind Nexus (Socrates F.)
 * DATE: 2025-10-24
 * VERSION: 1.8.0-final
 * =================================================================
 */

/* --- 1. V1.8 GOVERNANCE MANDATE --- */
const V1_8_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT = {
    M1_T1_COUNT_MANDATE: "All asset logic must adhere to the 8-15 T1_READY module subset.",
    M2_MAPPING_FIX: "All modules must contain explicit compatibleStages array (CR_ARCH_01 fix).",
    M3_EXPORT_LOCK: "Export is Static HTML View-Only (CR_ARCH_03 fix).",
    M4_TIME_GOVERNANCE: "All flows must support Time-to-Export validation telemetry (CR_RISK_01)."
};

/* --- 2. V1.8 EXECUTION PROOF --- */
const V1_8_EXECUTION_PROOF = {
    status: "V1.8-RESILIENCE-FINAL",
    integrityCheck: {
        composite_match: true,
        pss_signature_valid: true,
        jwt_valid: true
    },
    fix_status: {
        totalFixesMandated: 50,
        fixesExecuted: 50,
        taskingComplete: true
    },
    securityProtocol: {
        keyRotation: "RSA-PSS-4096 (Completed)",
        automationScripts: ["verify_v17_signature.sh", "rotate_and_resign_v17.sh"]
    }
};

/* --- 3. V1.3 AUDIT PAYLOAD --- */
const V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE = {
    strategic_mandate: "DEFER_AUTOMATION",
    current_blocker: "Asset Registry (Placeholder)",
    code_certification: "V1.3 RIGOR CERTIFIED (PR-B Fix Applied)",
    V1_3_LESSON_ASSEMBLER_CODE: "...",
    final_audit_synthesis: {
        architecture_verdict: "GO: The core V1.3 codebase is certified; the critical PR-B security flaw is neutralized.",
        strategic_verdict: "DEFER_AUTOMATION: The complexity of Launcher 2 (Node.js Pipeline) violates 'Elegant Simplicity' and must be deferred to Sprint 3 or later.",
        final_action: "UI construction is BLOCKED until the Master Curriculum Template and 60 Arsenal Concepts are finalized and committed to the Databank."
    }
};

/* --- 4. SMART ARSENAL LAUNCHER V1.8 --- */
const SmartArsenalLauncher = (() => {
    /* --- ERROR CLASS --- */
    class ArsenalError extends Error {
        constructor(message, code = 'ARSENAL_ERROR') {
            super(message);
            this.name = 'ArsenalError';
            this.code = code;
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.1 FILTER T1 MODULES --- */
    function filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        if (!Array.isArray(assetInventory)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Asset inventory must be an array', 'INVALID_INVENTORY');
        }
        if (assetInventory.length < 8 || assetInventory.length > 15) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Inventory must contain 8-15 T1 modules (M1_T1_COUNT_MANDATE)', 'INVALID_T1_COUNT');
        }

        return assetInventory.filter(mod => {
            if (!mod || typeof mod !== 'object' || !mod.id || !mod.type || !mod.stage || !mod.complexity || !Array.isArray(mod.compatibleStages)) {
                console.warn(`[FILTER] Skipping invalid module: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                return false;
            }
            return mod.type === 'T1' && (stageFilter ? mod.stage === stageFilter : true);
        });
    }

    /* --- 4.2 VALIDATE STAGE BALANCE --- */
    function validateModuleStageBalance(filteredModules) {
        if (!Array.isArray(filteredModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Filtered modules must be an array', 'INVALID_FILTERED_MODULES');
        }

        const stageMap = {};
        filteredModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageMap[mod.stage]) stageMap[mod.stage] = { simple: 0, complex: 0 };
            if (mod.complexity === 'simple') stageMap[mod.stage].simple++;
            else if (mod.complexity === 'complex') stageMap[mod.stage].complex++;
            else {
                console.warn(`[VALIDATION] Invalid complexity for module ${mod.id}: ${mod.complexity}`);
            }
        });

        const stageValidation = {};
        Object.keys(stageMap).forEach(stage => {
            stageValidation[stage] = stageMap[stage].simple >= 2;
        });
        return stageValidation;
    }

    /* --- 4.3 FETCH MARKET INSIGHTS --- */
    async function fetchMarketInsights() {
        try {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const marketData = {
                Stage1: { M01: 0.9, M02: 0.4, M03: 0.8 },
                Stage2: { M04: 0.6, M05: 0.95, M06: 0.85 },
                Stage3: { M07: 0.7, M08: 0.65, M09: 0.9, M10: 0.5 }
            };
            if (!marketData || Object.keys(marketData).length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('Market data is empty or invalid', 'INVALID_MARKET_DATA');
            }
            const endTime = performance.now();
            trackTimeToExport('fetchMarketInsights', endTime - startTime);
            return marketData;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Failed to fetch market insights: ${error.message}`, 'MARKET_FETCH_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.4 RANK MODULES WITH MARKET DATA --- */
    async function rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory, stageFilter = null) {
        try {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const marketData = await fetchMarketInsights();
            const t1Modules = filterT1Modules(assetInventory, stageFilter);

            if (t1Modules.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No T1 modules found after filtering', 'NO_T1_MODULES');
            }

            const ranked = t1Modules
                .map(mod => {
                    const marketScore = marketData[mod.stage]?.[mod.id] || 0;
                    const complexityScore = mod.complexity === 'simple' ? 1 : mod.complexity === 'complex' ? 0.7 : 0;
                    return { ...mod, score: marketScore * 0.6 + complexityScore * 0.4 };
                })
                .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
            const endTime = performance.now();
            trackTimeToExport('rankModulesWithMarketData', endTime - startTime);
            return ranked;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Ranking failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'RANKING_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.5 GROUP TOP N MODULES PER STAGE --- */
    function groupTopNModules(rankedModules, N = 3) {
        if (!Array.isArray(rankedModules)) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Ranked modules must be an array', 'INVALID_RANKED_MODULES');
        }
        if (!Number.isInteger(N) || N <= 0) {
            throw new ArsenalError('N must be a positive integer', 'INVALID_N_VALUE');
        }

        const stageGroups = {};
        rankedModules.forEach(mod => {
            if (!stageGroups[mod.stage]) stageGroups[mod.stage] = [];
            if (stageGroups[mod.stage].length < N) stageGroups[mod.stage].push(mod);
        });
        return stageGroups;
    }

    /* --- 4.6 RENDER DASHBOARD --- */
    function renderLauncherDashboard(stageGroups) {
        const container = document.getElementById('dashboard');
        if (!container) {
            throw new ArsenalError('Dashboard container element not found', 'NO_DASHBOARD_CONTAINER');
        }

        try {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear previous content

            if (!stageGroups || Object.keys(stageGroups).length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<p>No modules available to display.</p>';
                return;
            }

            Object.keys(stageGroups).forEach(stage => {
                const stageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                stageDiv.className = 'stage-group';
                stageDiv.innerHTML = `<h3>${stage}</h3>`;
                const list = document.createElement('ul');

                stageGroups[stage].forEach(mod => {
                    if (!mod.id || !mod.score) {
                        console.warn(`[RENDER] Skipping invalid module in ${stage}: ${JSON.stringify(mod)}`);
                        return;
                    }
                    const item = document.createElement('li');
                    item.innerHTML = `${mod.id} (${mod.complexity}) â€“ Score: ${mod.score.toFixed(2)}`;
                    item.addEventListener('click', () => trackModuleSelection(mod.id));
                    list.appendChild(item);
                });

                stageDiv.appendChild(list);
                container.appendChild(stageDiv);
            });
            const endTime = performance.now();
            trackTimeToExport('renderLauncherDashboard', endTime - startTime);
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Dashboard rendering failed: ${error.message}`, 'RENDER_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.7 TELEMETRY HOOK --- */
    function trackModuleSelection(moduleId) {
        if (!moduleId || typeof moduleId !== 'string') {
            console.warn('[TELEMETRY] Invalid module ID:', moduleId);
            return;
        }
        console.log(`[TELEMETRY] Module selected: ${moduleId}`);
        // Placeholder for backend telemetry integration
    }

    /* --- 4.8 TIME-TO-EXPORT TELEMETRY --- */
    function trackTimeToExport(operation, duration) {
        console.log(`[TELEMETRY] ${operation} completed in ${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`);
        // Placeholder: Send to telemetry endpoint
    }

    /* --- 4.9 FULL EXECUTION --- */
    async function executeFullSmartArsenal(assetInventory) {
        try {
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Starting Full Smart Arsenal Launch...');

            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                throw new ArsenalError('No valid T1 modules found', 'NO_VALID_MODULES');
            }
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Stage Balance:', balance);

            const ranked = await rankModulesWithMarketData(assetInventory);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Ranked Modules:', ranked);

            const topModules = groupTopNModules(ranked);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Top Modules per Stage:', topModules);

            renderLauncherDashboard(topModules);
            console.log('[EXECUTION] Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 Ready.');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`[EXECUTION ERROR] ${error.name}: ${error.message} (Code: ${error.code})`);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.10 AUDIT REPORT --- */
    function auditBoardReport(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const filtered = filterT1Modules(assetInventory);
            const balance = validateModuleStageBalance(filtered);
            const issues = Object.entries(balance)
                .filter(([_, valid]) => !valid)
                .map(([stage]) => stage);
            return { totalModules: filtered.length, balanceIssues: issues, passed: issues.length === 0 };
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Audit failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'AUDIT_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.11 PREPARE FOR GROK/CHATTY --- */
    function prepareForGrok(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const auditReport = auditBoardReport(assetInventory);
            const payload = {
                inventory: assetInventory,
                launcherAudit: auditReport,
                v1_3Audit: V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE,
                v1_8Governance: V1_8_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT,
                v1_8ExecutionProof: V1_8_EXECUTION_PROOF,
                v1_8ReverseEngineering: {
                    SmartArsenalSelector: filterT1Modules.toString(),
                    StaticExportRenderer: renderLauncherDashboard.toString(),
                    TelemetrySchema: { operation: String, duration: Number },
                    ComplexityCheckLogic: validateModuleStageBalance.toString()
                },
                instructions: "Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8: Use this framework for stage-aware, market-ranked, T1 module deployment. Integrates V1.3 audit and V1.8 governance for compliance."
            };
            console.log('[GROK HANDOFF] Payload Ready:', payload);
            return payload;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Grok handoff preparation failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'GROK_HANDOFF_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.12 FINAL DISPATCH --- */
    async function dispatchFinalHandoff() {
        try {
            console.log('[MASTERMIND] Initiating final deployment hand-off to Chatty...');
            const payload = prepareForGrok([]);
            console.log('[STATUS] Full V1.8 Deployment context packaged and ready for Chatty\'s archival.');
            console.log('[NEXT ACTION] Chatty must verify structural compliance before logging to Codex.');
            return payload;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Dispatch failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'DISPATCH_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- 4.13 CODIFY FOR ARCHIVAL --- */
    function codifyForArchival(assetInventory) {
        try {
            const payload = prepareForGrok(assetInventory);
            return {
                version: "1.8.0-final",
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                code: {
                    SmartArsenalLauncher: {
                        filterT1Modules: filterT1Modules.toString(),
                        validateModuleStageBalance: validateModuleStageBalance.toString(),
                        rankModulesWithMarketData: rankModulesWithMarketData.toString(),
                        groupTopNModules: groupTopNModules.toString(),
                        renderLauncherDashboard: renderLauncherDashboard.toString(),
                        trackModuleSelection: trackModuleSelection.toString(),
                        trackTimeToExport: trackTimeToExport.toString(),
                        executeFullSmartArsenal: executeFullSmartArsenal.toString(),
                        auditBoardReport: auditBoardReport.toString(),
                        prepareForGrok: prepareForGrok.toString(),
                        dispatchFinalHandoff: dispatchFinalHandoff.toString()
                    }
                },
                metadata: {
                    v1_8Governance: V1_8_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT,
                    v1_8ExecutionProof: V1_8_EXECUTION_PROOF,
                    v1_3Audit: V1_3_AUDIT_PACKAGE
                },
                handoffPayload: payload
            };
        } catch (error) {
            throw new ArsenalError(`Codification failed: ${error.message}`, error.code || 'CODIFY_ERROR');
        }
    }

    /* --- EXPORTS --- */
    return {
        filterT1Modules,
        validateModuleStageBalance,
        rankModulesWithMarketData,
        groupTopNModules,
        renderLauncherDashboard,
        trackModuleSelection,
        trackTimeToExport,
        executeFullSmartArsenal,
        auditBoardReport,
        prepareForGrok,
        dispatchFinalHandoff,
        codifyForArchival
    };
})();

/* --- 5. GLOBAL EXPOSURE AND CONSOLE REPORT --- */
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.SmartArsenalLauncher = SmartArsenalLauncher;

# Smart Arsenal Launcher V1.8 + V1.3 Audit + V1.8 Handoff â€“ Chatty-Ready

A self-contained JavaScript module integrating the V1.8 Smart Arsenal Launcher, V1.3 audit payload, and V1.8 deployment context for stage-aware, market-driven T1 module deployment, compliance tracking, and Chatty archival.

## Setup
1. Extract the `smart-arsenal-v1.8` folder.
2. Serve using a web server (e.g., `npx http-server`).
3. Open `index.html` in a browser to view the dashboard.
4. Replace `sample-inventory.json` with your `FINAL_T1_ASSET_INVENTORY` for production.

        .record-btn:hover { background-color: #059669; }
        .stop-btn { background-color: #EF4444; color: white; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 0.3s; }

    <script type="text/javascript">
        var gk_isXlsx = false;
        var gk_xlsxFileLookup = {};
        var gk_fileData = {};
        function filledCell(cell) {
          return cell !== '' && cell != null;
        }
        function loadFileData(filename) {
            if (gk_isXlsx && gk_xlsxFileLookup[filename]) {
                try {
                    var workbook = XLSX.read(gk_fileData[filename], { type: 'base64' });
                    var firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
                    var worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];
                    var jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1, blankrows: false, defval: '' });
                    var filteredData = jsonData.filter(row => row.some(filledCell));
                    var headerRowIndex = filteredData.findIndex((row, index) =>
                      row.filter(filledCell).length >= filteredData[index + 1]?.filter(filledCell).length
                    );
                    if (headerRowIndex === -1 || headerRowIndex > 25) {
                      headerRowIndex = 0;
                    }
                    var csv = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(filteredData.slice(headerRowIndex));
                    csv = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_csv(csv, { header: 1 });
                    return csv;
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error(e);
                    return "";
                }
            }
            return gk_fileData[filename] || "";
        }

        // Slider Value Display
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(slider => {
            const valueSpan = document.getElementById(slider.id + '-value');
            if (valueSpan) {
                slider.addEventListener('input', () => valueSpan.textContent = slider.value);
            }
        });

        // Writing Test Word Count
        const writingTextarea = document.getElementById('writing-test');
        const wordCountSpan = document.getElementById('word-count');
        writingTextarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const words = writingTextarea.value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(word => word.length > 0).length;
            wordCountSpan.textContent = words;
        });

        // Voice Recording Functionality
        function setupRecorder(startBtnId, stopBtnId, playbackId, statusId, inputName) {
            let mediaRecorder;
            let audioChunks = [];
            const startBtn = document.getElementById(startBtnId);
            const stopBtn = document.getElementById(stopBtnId);
            const playback = document.getElementById(playbackId);
            const status = document.getElementById(statusId);

            startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                try {
                    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                    mediaRecorder.start();
                    audioChunks = [];
                    mediaRecorder.addEventListener('dataavailable', event => audioChunks.push(event.data));
                    mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {
                        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/wav' });
                        playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob);

can I do it without a server, like have it email to me, or have it download for the student and they can give it to me? troubleshoot
Yes, you can handle the form submission without a server by either having the form data emailed directly to you or allowing the student to download the data (including text and audio recordings) as files they can send to you. Both approaches are feasible with client-side JavaScript, though each has limitations and potential issues to troubleshoot. Below, Iâ€™ll explain both options, provide code modifications for the kidsâ€™ version of the assessment, and address potential troubleshooting concerns.

Option 1: Email the Form Data Directly
You can configure the form to send data to an email address using the mailto: protocol in the formâ€™s action attribute. This opens the userâ€™s default email client (e.g., Outlook, Gmail) with a pre-filled email containing the form data. However, this method has limitations, especially with audio files.

Implementation
Modify the <form> tag in the kidsâ€™ version HTML to use a mailto: action, and adjust the JavaScript to handle the submission. Hereâ€™s how:

Update the Form Tag:
Change the <form> tag to include the mailto: action with your email address. For example:

html
<form id="assessment-form" class="space-y-8" enctype="multipart/form-data" action="mailto:your.email@example.com" method="POST" enctype="text/plain">
Replace your.email@example.com with your actual email address.
Set enctype="text/plain" to make the email body readable (instead of multipart/form-data, which isnâ€™t well-suited for mailto).
Remove JavaScript Submission Handling:
Since the form will use the mailto: action, you can remove the JavaScript that prevents default submission and logs to the console. However, to handle audio recordings (which mailto canâ€™t directly include), youâ€™ll need to modify the recording logic to prompt users to download audio files separately (see Option 2 for audio handling).

Modified Form Example:
Replace the <form> tag in the kidsâ€™ version with:

<form id="assessment-form" class="space-y-8" action="mailto:your.email@example.com" method="POST" enctype="text/plain">
Keep the rest of the form content (inputs, textareas, etc.) unchanged.

JavaScript for Audio Downloads:
Since mailto canâ€™t send large binary data like audio files, modify the setupRecorder function to prompt users to download their audio recordings as files. Update the setupRecorder function in the <script> section:

javascript
function setupRecorder(startBtnId, stopBtnId, playbackId, statusId, inputName) {
    let mediaRecorder;
    let audioChunks = [];
    const startBtn = document.getElementById(startBtnId);
    const stopBtn = document.getElementById(stopBtnId);

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);

    startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMicrophone({ audio: true });
            mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            mediaRecorder.start();

            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {

                link.href = url;
                link.download = `${inputName}.wav`; // e.g., writing_voice_recording.wav
                link.click();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });
            startBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
            status.textContent = 'Recording... Speak loud and clear! (Äang ghi Ã¢m... NÃ³i to vÃ  rÃµ rÃ ng!)';
        } catch (err) {
            status.textContent = 'Oops! Microphone problem: ' + err.message + ' (Ã”i! CÃ³ váº¥n Ä‘á» vá»›i micro: ' + err.message + ')';
        }
    });

    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mediaRecorder.stop();

        stopBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        status.textContent = 'Recording stopped! Listen to your voice below and save the file. (Ghi Ã¢m dá»«ng! Nghe giá»ng cá»§a báº¡n dÆ°á»›i Ä‘Ã¢y vÃ  lÆ°u tá»‡p.)';
    });
}
How It Works:

When the student submits the form, their email client opens with a pre-filled email containing all text inputs (e.g., name, age, answers) in a readable format.
Audio recordings are automatically downloaded as .wav files when the student stops each recording (e.g., writing_voice_recording.wav, phonics_g12_voice_recording.wav).
The student can attach these downloaded audio files to the email manually or send them to you separately (e.g., via a messaging app or file-sharing service).
Troubleshooting for Email Option
Issue: Email Client Not Opening:
Cause: The studentâ€™s device may not have a default email client configured (common on some mobile devices or browsers).
Solution: Instruct students to set up an email client (e.g., Gmail, Outlook) or use Option 2 (downloading all data) instead. Alternatively, add a fallback alert:

Issue: Audio Files Not Included:
Cause: The mailto protocol doesnâ€™t support attaching binary files like audio.

Issue: Large Form Data Truncated:
Cause: Some email clients limit the size of mailto URLs, truncating long form data.

Issue: Students Donâ€™t Send Audio Files:
Cause: Students may forget to attach the downloaded audio files.

How It Works
Text Data:
When the student clicks the "Send Your Adventure for Review!" button, the form collects all text inputs (e.g., name, age, favorite thing, answers to listening and reading questions, etc.) into a FormData object.
The JavaScript converts this into a JSON object, excluding audio blobs, and creates a file named english_adventure_data.json.
The browser prompts the student to download this JSON file, which contains all their text responses in a structured format.
Audio Recordings:
Each time a student stops a recording (for the writing test or one of the three phonics tests), the audio is saved as a .wav file (e.g., writing_voice_recording.wav, phonics_g12_voice_recording.wav, etc.) and automatically downloaded.
A hidden input is added to the form with a placeholder value (downloaded) to indicate the audio was saved, though this isnâ€™t strictly necessary for the JSON file.
Student Action:
After completing the form, the student will have five files in their downloads folder:
english_adventure_data.json (text responses)
writing_voice_recording.wav (writing test audio)
phonics_g12_voice_recording.wav (phonics groups 1+2 audio)
phonics_g34_voice_recording.wav (phonics groups 3+4 audio)
phonics_g57_voice_recording.wav (phonics groups 5â€“7 audio)
The student must send these files to you, e.g., by attaching them to an email to teacher@example.com, uploading to Google Drive, or delivering them in person (e.g., on a USB drive).

Here are potential issues and solutions to ensure the download process works smoothly:

Issue: Audio Files Not Downloading:
Cause: The browser may not have microphone permissions, or the MediaRecorder API is not supported.
Solution:
Ensure the student is using a modern browser (e.g., Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and has granted microphone access (a prompt should appear when clicking "Start Recording").
Check the browser console (F12 â†’ Console) for errors like NotAllowedError. If errors occur, instruct the student to allow microphone access in browser settings.
Test on a different device or browser if issues persist.

            normalizedEER: normalizedScore.toFixed(2),
            rank: rankResult.rank,

        };

<script type="text/javascript">
        var gk_isXlsx = false;
        var gk_xlsxFileLookup = {};
        var gk_fileData = {};
        function filledCell(cell) {
          return cell !== '' && cell != null;
        }
        function loadFileData(filename) {
        if (gk_isXlsx && gk_xlsxFileLookup[filename]) {
            try {
                var workbook = XLSX.read(gk_fileData[filename], { type: 'base64' });
                var firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
                var worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];

                // Convert sheet to JSON to filter blank rows
                var jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1, blankrows: false, defval: '' });
                // Filter out blank rows (rows where all cells are empty, null, or undefined)
                var filteredData = jsonData.filter(row => row.some(filledCell));

                // Heuristic to find the header row by ignoring rows with fewer filled cells than the next row
                var headerRowIndex = filteredData.findIndex((row, index) =>
                  row.filter(filledCell).length >= filteredData[index + 1]?.filter(filledCell).length
                );
                // Fallback
                if (headerRowIndex === -1 || headerRowIndex > 25) {
                  headerRowIndex = 0;
                }

                // Convert filtered JSON back to CSV
                var csv = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(filteredData.slice(headerRowIndex)); // Create a new sheet from filtered array of arrays
                csv = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_csv(csv, { header: 1 });
                return csv;
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(e);
                return "";
            }
        }
        return gk_fileData[filename] || "";
        }

    <script>
        // Slider Value Display
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(slider => {
            const valueSpan = document.getElementById(slider.id + '-value');
            if (valueSpan) {
                slider.addEventListener('input', () => valueSpan.textContent = slider.value);
            }
        });

        // Writing Test Word Count
        const writingTextarea = document.getElementById('writing-test');
        const wordCountSpan = document.getElementById('word-count');
        writingTextarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const words = writingTextarea.value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(word => word.length > 0).length;
            wordCountSpan.textContent = words;
        });

        // Voice Recording Functionality
        function setupRecorder(startBtnId, stopBtnId, playbackId, statusId, inputName) {
            let mediaRecorder;
            let audioChunks = [];
            const startBtn = document.getElementById(startBtnId);
            const stopBtn = document.getElementById(stopBtnId);
            const playback = document.getElementById(playbackId);
            const status = document.getElementById(statusId);

            startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                try {
                    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                    mediaRecorder.start();
                    audioChunks = [];
                    mediaRecorder.addEventListener('dataavailable', event => audioChunks.push(event.data));
                    mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {
                        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/wav' });
                        playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob);
                        playback.classList.remove('hidden');
                        const input = document.createElement('input');
                        input.type = 'hidden';
                        input.name = inputName;
                        input.value = audioBlob; // Simulated for form submission
                        document.getElementById('assessment-form').appendChild(input);
                    });
                    startBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                    stopBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                    status.textContent = 'Recording... Read the content aloud clearly. / Äang ghi Ã¢m... Äá»c to ná»™i dung má»™t cÃ¡ch rÃµ rÃ ng.';
                } catch (err) {
                    status.textContent = 'Error accessing microphone: ' + err.message + ' / Lá»—i khi truy cáº­p micro: ' + err.message;
                }
            });

            stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                mediaRecorder.stop();
                startBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                stopBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                status.textContent = 'Recording stopped. Listen to your playback below. / Ghi Ã¢m Ä‘Ã£ dá»«ng. Nghe láº¡i báº£n ghi Ã¢m bÃªn dÆ°á»›i.';
            });
        }

        // Setup recorders for Writing and Phonics sections
        setupRecorder('start-writing-recording', 'stop-writing-recording', 'writing-audio-playback', 'writing-recording-status', 'writing_voice_recording');
        setupRecorder('start-phonics-recording', 'stop-phonics-recording', 'phonics-audio-playback', 'phonics-recording-status', 'phonics_voice_recording');

        // Form Submission (Simulated - Log to Console)
        document.getElementById('assessment-form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {

            alert('Thank you! Your assessment has been submitted for instructor review. You will receive your NET Ranking after your recordings are evaluated. / Cáº£m Æ¡n báº¡n!         });
    </script>
</body>

function setupRecorder(startId, stopId, playbackId) {
    const startBtn = document.getElementById(startId);
    const stopBtn = document.getElementById(stopId);
    const playback = document.getElementById(playbackId);
    let mediaRecorder, audioChunks = [];

    startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
            mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            
            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('dataavailable', e => audioChunks.push(e.data));
            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {
                const blob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/wav' });
                playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                playback.classList.remove('hidden');
                
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.download = 'pronunciation_practice.wav';
                link.click();
                
                stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
            });

            audioChunks = [];
            mediaRecorder.start();
            startBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } catch (err) {
            alert('Microphone access denied.');
        }
    });

    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorder.stop();
            startBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });
}

    // ========================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ========================================================================
    utils: {
        update: function(user_input) {
            masterBrain.master_glossary.active_working_section.addUpdate(
                "brain", 
                "Master_Brain", 
                "update", 
                `Updated with input: ${user_input.slice(0, 50)}...`
            );
            masterBrain.last_updated = new Date().toISOString();
            console.log("âœ… Master Brain updated successfully");
        },
        
        getVocabByLevel: function(level) {
            const content = masterBrain.master_glossary.content_sub_brain;
            const allLevels = [
                ...content.student_rankings.beginner_levels,
                ...content.student_rankings.intermediate_levels
            ];
            return allLevels
                .filter(entry => entry.rank === level || entry.sublevel === level)
                .flatMap(entry => entry.vocabulary);
        },
        
        getMethodsByTopic: function(topic) {
            return masterBrain.master_glossary.methodology_sub_brain.core_methodologies
                .filter(entry => entry.topic === topic);
        },
        
        approveLayout: function(layoutName) {
            const layouts = masterBrain.master_glossary.design_sub_brain.layouts;
            const layout = layouts.find(l => l.name === layoutName);
            if (layout) {
                layout.approved = true;
                console.log(`âœ… Layout "${layoutName}" approved for production use.`);
            }
        },
        
        logSuccess: function(message) {
            console.log(`âœ… ${message}`);
            masterBrain.master_glossary.active_working_section.addUpdate(
                "brain",
                "Master_Brain",
                "success",
                message
            );
        },
        
        logError: function(message) {
            console.error(`âŒ ${message}`);
            masterBrain.master_glossary.active_working_section.addUpdate(
                "brain",
                "Master_Brain",
                "error",
                message
            );
        },
        
        addTodo: function(task, priority = "medium", category = "short_term") {
            const logicCenter = masterBrain.left_brain_logic_center;
            const todoList = category === "immediate" ? logicCenter.immediate_todos :
                            category === "short_term" ? logicCenter.short_term_todos :
                            logicCenter.mid_term_todos;
            
            todoList.push({
                task: task,
                status: "pending",
                priority: priority,
                added: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            console.log(`âœ… Added to ${category} todos: ${task}`);
        },
        
        addIdea: function(idea, description, relatedSubBrains = []) {
            masterBrain.brain_storm.active_ideas.push({
                idea: idea,
                description: description,
                status: "new",
                related_sub_brains: relatedSubBrains,
                added: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            console.log(`ðŸ’¡ New idea logged: ${idea}`);
        }
    },

function setupRecorder(startId, stopId, playbackId) {
    const startBtn = document.getElementById(startId);
    const stopBtn = document.getElementById(stopId);
    const playback = document.getElementById(playbackId);
    let mediaRecorder, audioChunks = [];

    startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
            mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            
            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('dataavailable', e => audioChunks.push(e.data));
            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {
                const blob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/wav' });
                playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                playback.classList.remove('hidden');
                
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.download = 'pronunciation_practice.wav';
                link.click();
                
                stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
            });

            audioChunks = [];
            mediaRecorder.start();
            startBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } catch (err) {
            alert('Microphone access denied.');
        }
    });

    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorder.stop();
            startBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });
}

:root {
    /* NET Official Gold Colors */
    --color-primary-gold: #D4AF37;
    --color-gold-light: #F4E4A6;
    --color-gold-dark: #B8941E;
    
    /* NET Official Purple Colors */
    --color-primary-purple: #6B4C9A;
    --color-purple-light: #9B7CB8;
    --color-purple-accent: #8B6FB0;
    
    /* NET Background & Neutral Colors */
    --color-bg-dark: #1A1A2E;
    --color-bg-card: #2D2D44;
    --color-text-light: #FFFFFF;
    --color-text-muted: #C8C8D8;
    
    /* Functional Colors */
    --color-success: #10B981;
    --color-warning: #F59E0B;
    --color-error: #EF4444;
}

/* Cosmic Background */
body {
    font-family: 'Poppins', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: var(--color-bg-dark);
    background-image: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(107, 76, 154, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 40% 20%, rgba(155, 124, 184, 0.1) 0%, transparent 40%);
}

/* Navigation Tabs */
.nav-tab {
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple-accent) 0%, var(--color-primary-purple) 100%);
    color: var(--color-text-light);
    border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
    border-radius: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
.nav-tab:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-gold) 0%, var(--color-gold-dark) 100%);
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
}
.nav-tab.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-gold-light) 0%, var(--color-primary-gold) 100%);
    color: var(--color-bg-dark);
    border-color: var(--color-gold-dark);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5);
}

/* Section Card with Sweep Animation */
.section-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-bg-card) 0%, rgba(45, 45, 68, 0.8) 100%);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: all 0.4s ease;
}
.section-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: -100%;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1), transparent);
    transition: left 0.6s ease;
}
.section-card:hover::before {
    left: 100%;
}
.section-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

/* Badges */
.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin: 0.25rem;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
.badge-gold {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-gold) 0%, var(--color-gold-dark) 100%);
    color: var(--color-bg-dark);
}
.badge-purple {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-purple-light) 0%, var(--color-primary-purple) 100%);
    color: var(--color-text-light);
}
.badge-important {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCA5A5 0%, var(--color-error) 100%);
    color: white;
}
.badge-success {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6EE7B7 0%, var(--color-success) 100%);
    color: var(--color-bg-dark);
}

/* Alert Boxes */
.alert {
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
    border-left: 4px solid;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
.alert-important {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2) 0%, rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1) 100%);
    border-color: var(--color-error);
}
.alert-warning {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2) 0%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1) 100%);
    border-color: var(--color-warning);
}
.alert-info {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2) 0%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) 100%);
    border-color: var(--color-primary-gold);
}

/* Hover Cards */
.hover-card {
    background: rgba(45, 45, 68, 0.6);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin: 1rem 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s ease;
    border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
}
.hover-card:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-purple) 0%, var(--color-purple-accent) 100%);
    transform: translateX(10px);
    border-color: var(--color-primary-gold);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
}
.hover-detail {
    display: none;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    padding-top: 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    color: var(--color-gold-light);
}
.hover-card:hover .hover-detail {
    display: block;
}

/* Stat Cards */
.stat-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(107, 76, 154, 0.3) 0%, rgba(107, 76, 154, 0.1) 100%);
    padding: 2rem;
    border-radius: 16px;
    text-align: center;
    border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.stat-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
}
.stat-number {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-gold-light) 0%, var(--color-primary-gold) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
}

/* Practice Word Grid */
.practice-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
}
.practice-word {
    background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    color: var(--color-gold-light);
    border: 2px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.practice-word:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-gold) 0%, var(--color-gold-dark) 100%);
    color: var(--color-bg-dark);
    transform: scale(1.1);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
}

/* NET Logo Header */
.net-header {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 3rem 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    position: relative;
}
.net-header::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 300px;
    height: 300px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
    filter: blur(60px);
    z-index: 0;
}
.net-logo h1 {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-gold-light) 0%, var(--color-primary-gold) 50%, var(--color-gold-dark) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

        {
            name: "setupRecorder",
            type: "js",
            content: `
function setupRecorder(startId, stopId, playbackId) {
    const startBtn = document.getElementById(startId);
    const stopBtn = document.getElementById(stopId);
    const playback = document.getElementById(playbackId);
    let mediaRecorder, audioChunks = [];

    startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
            mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
            
            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('dataavailable', e => audioChunks.push(e.data));
            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {
                const blob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/wav' });
                playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                playback.classList.remove('hidden');
                
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.download = 'pronunciation_practice.wav';
                link.click();
                
                stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
            });

            audioChunks = [];
            mediaRecorder.start();
            startBtn.classList.add('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } catch (err) {
            alert('Microphone access denied.');
        }
    });

    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
            mediaRecorder.stop();
            startBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
            stopBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });
}
